typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblOpicsCashSweepTrades1a_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BR as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		FROM_TRADER as string,
		FROM_PORT as string,
		FROM_COST as string,
		CCY as string,
		CTR as string,
		FROM_CCYAMT as string,
		FROM_CTRAMT as string,
		TO_TRADER as string,
		TO_PORT as string,
		TO_COST as string,
		TO_CCY as string,
		TO_CTR as string,
		TO_CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		TO_CTRAMT as decimal(19,4),
		RECORDCREATIONDATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromopicsplusdbcppr
fromopicsplusdbcppr derive({Copy of TO_CCY} = TO_CCY,
		{Copy of TO_PORT} = TO_PORT,
		{Copy of CTR} = CTR,
		{Copy of FROM_TRADER} = FROM_TRADER,
		{Copy of TO_TRADER} = TO_TRADER,
		{Copy of FROM_COST} = FROM_COST,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of VDATE} = VDATE,
		{Copy of TO_CTRAMT} = TO_CTRAMT,
		{Copy of RECORDCREATIONDATE} = RECORDCREATIONDATE,
		{Copy of FROM_CTRAMT} = FROM_CTRAMT,
		{Copy of TO_COST} = TO_COST,
		{Copy of FROM_PORT} = FROM_PORT,
		{Copy of TO_CCYAMT} = TO_CCYAMT,
		{Copy of TO_CTR} = TO_CTR,
		{Copy of FROM_CCYAMT} = FROM_CCYAMT,
		{Copy of BR} = BR) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		FROM_COST as string,
		CTR as string,
		TO_CTR as string,
		FROM_CCYAMT as double,
		TO_COST as string,
		TO_TRADER as string,
		TO_CCY as string,
		FROM_CTRAMT as double,
		TO_CTRAMT as double,
		BR as string,
		FROM_TRADER as string,
		CCY as string,
		recordCreationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TO_CCYAMT as double,
		FROM_PORT as string,
		VDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TO_PORT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FROM_COST = {Copy of FROM_COST},
		CTR = {Copy of CTR},
		TO_CTR = {Copy of TO_CTR},
		FROM_CCYAMT,
		TO_COST = {Copy of TO_COST},
		TO_TRADER = {Copy of TO_TRADER},
		TO_CCY = {Copy of TO_CCY},
		FROM_CTRAMT,
		TO_CTRAMT,
		BR = {Copy of BR},
		FROM_TRADER = {Copy of FROM_TRADER},
		CCY = {Copy of CCY},
		recordCreationDate = RECORDCREATIONDATE,
		TO_CCYAMT,
		FROM_PORT = {Copy of FROM_PORT},
		VDATE,
		TO_PORT = {Copy of TO_PORT}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblOpicsCashSweepTrades1a_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblOpicsCashSweepTrades1a
